docs.summary: Builds a texture's [`Sprite`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Resources.Sprite) sub-assets from its [`SpriteImportSettings`](#api~Prowl.Editor.Importers.SpriteImportSettings). Single mode yields one full-texture sprite; Multiple yields one per slice. Handles pivot-unit conversion, per-sprite border, secondary maps, and optional tight-mesh tracing.

members.signature: public static SubAssetIdentity IdentityOf(SpriteImportSettings s, SpriteSliceData slice)

docs.summary: The identity seeding a slice's sub-asset GUID. Always an explicit key, never order: slices are a user-edited list, and the grid slicer skips cells that become fully transparent, so an index here tracks neither the slice nor anything stable about it.

members.name: Build
members.signature: public static List<(SpriteSliceData slice, Sprite sprite)> Build(Texture2D tex, SpriteImportSettings s, int sourceWidth, int sourceHeight, byte[]? pixels)

docs.summary: Builds Sprite sub-assets from the texture and its sprite settings. Slices, borders and pivots are authored in the source image's pixels and scaled to the imported size, so a Max Size limit changes neither where a sprite cuts nor how large it is in the world. Single mode always covers the whole texture. `pixels` are the imported RGBA8 texels tight meshes trace.
The alpha channel of RGBA8 texels.
